# How this site is generated

> The docs are generated by fw site from fw --help, the MCP server, cargo metadata, product files and the release manifest, and checked for drift in CI.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/guides/docs-site/

This site is generated. A person edits code, not pages.

## Commands

```bash
fw site gen      # write apps/docs from the code
fw site check    # fail when a generated file differs from the code
fw site llms     # write llms.txt and llms-full.txt
```

## Sources

| Pages | Source |
|---|---|
| [CLI reference](/cli/) | `fw --help` and `fw <command> --help` of the built binary (64 commands) |
| [MCP tools](/mcp/) | `tools/list` of the MCP server in `src/fw_cli.ts` (17 tools) |
| [API reference](/api/) | `fw openapi`, `crates/fw-edge/data` and `ay/docs/auto/openapi.json` |
| [Crates](/crates/) | `cargo metadata --no-deps` (384 packages) |
| [Products](/products/fw/) | `product.toml`, `aphrody/product.toml` and `ay/ay.toml` |
| [Releases](/releases/) | `release.toml` and the live release manifest |
| Colors | `fw-m3 css` from the `[brand]` seed in `product.toml` |

Every page has a `generated` front-matter field with its inputs and a short hash. `fw site check` regenerates in memory and compares. A scheduled workflow refreshes the live site every six hours.
